lines.primary: Hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐqián, shān shàng yǒu yì zhī shíhóu.
lines.hanzi: 很久很久以前，山上有一只石猴。
lines.english: A very long time ago, a stone monkey lived on a mountain.

lines.primary: Yì tiān wǎnshang, yuèliang hěn dà, hěn liàng.
lines.hanzi: 一天晚上，月亮很大，很亮。
lines.english: One night, the moon was big and bright.

lines.primary: Shān xià yǒu yì kǒu jǐng.
lines.english: At the foot of the hill there was a well.

lines.primary: Wùkōng dītóu yí kàn, yuèliang zài shuǐ lǐ.
lines.hanzi: 悟空低头一看，月亮在水里。
lines.english: Wukong lowered his head and looked: the moon was in the water.

lines.primary: “Yuèliang diào jìn jǐng lǐ le!” tā dà jiào.
lines.english: “The moon has fallen into the well!” he cried.

lines.primary: Tā xiǎng bǎ yuèliang ná chūlái.
lines.english: He wanted to take the moon out.

lines.primary: Tā zhǎo lái yì gēn chángcháng de gùnzi.
lines.hanzi: 他找来一根长长的棍子。

lines.primary: Tā bǎ gùnzi shēn jìn jǐng lǐ.
lines.english: He put the stick into the well.

lines.primary: Shuǐ dòng le, yuèliang suì le.
lines.english: The water moved, and the moon broke into pieces.

lines.primary: Shuǐ mànmàn de bú dòng le.
Yuèliang yòu huílái le, háishi nàme yuán.
lines.hanzi: 月亮又回来了，还是那么圆。
lines.english: The moon came back, as round as before.

lines.primary: Wùkōng kànzhe shuǐ lǐ de yuèliang, xiào le.
lines.hanzi: 悟空看着水里的月亮，笑了。
lines.english: Wukong looked at the moon in the water and smiled.

lines.primary: Tā bú zài qù zhuā yuèliang le.
lines.english: He did not try to catch the moon again.

lines.primary: Tiān shàng yǒu yí gè, shuǐ lǐ yě yǒu yí gè.
lines.hanzi: 天上有一个，水里也有一个。
lines.english: One in the sky, one in the water.

lines.primary: Nǎ yí gè shì zhēn de?
Fēng chuī guòlái, shān hěn ānjìng.
lines.english: The wind blew, and the mountain was quiet.

topic: Sun Wukong and the moon's reflection in a well
synopsis: Wukong tries to pull the moon out of a well and learns to leave a reflection alone.
